title: Convert Triage to Findings
description: Bridges /troubleshoot triage state JSON into canonical troubleshoot_findings.json conforming to Schema v2.2.
instruction: python3 tools/scripts/handoff/convert_triage_to_findings.py$(if [ -n '${triage_json}' ]; then echo " --triage_json=${triage_json}"; fi)$(if [ -n '${workload}' ]; then echo " --workload=${workload}"; fi) --case_id=${case_id} --output_file=${output_file} --bucket=${bucket}

triage_json.description: Path to input triage state JSON

workload.description: Optional target workload name to automatically locate newest scratch triage state JSON
